row.body: The manor tour key is signed out beside a field note asking the guide to keep visitors away from the north lawn until the test is over.
row.title: The Saturday tour key

sidecar.gloss: A public tour shares a schedule with a restricted lawn test.
sidecar.rival_reading: A containment crew could close the lawn during cleanup; the note does not identify the test material.

row.body: the measuring tape and empty garden sprayer share two stains: sweet field residue below and bleach above. both could have been packed during either job.
row.title: two traces on the measuring tape

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.
